name: Two-patch example (Reimer, Mangel, Derocher & Lewis 2019)
description: Illustrative patch-choice model from Reimer et al. (2019) Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 'Matrix methods for stochastic dynamic programming in ecology and evolutionary biology' (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.2547815 for their Matlab code). Five energy states x = 1..5 plus death at x = 0. Patch 1: finds food with probability 0.4, survives the period with probability 0.99. Patch 2: finds food with probability 0.8, survives with probability 0.891. Food adds 3 units and the metabolic cost is 1 (net +2); no food costs 1. An individual at x = 1 that finds no food dies. PUBLISHED RESULT (verified from the paper's text): far from the horizon the optimal policy is patch 2 at x = 1, 2 and patch 1 at x = 3, 4, 5, and the long-run per-period survival (dominant eigenvalue) is 0.97. The test suite checks both.
